title: Patterns behind Chaos: Forecasting Data Movement for Efficient Large-Scale MoE LLM Inference
authors: Zhongkai Yu; Yue Guan; Zihao Yu; Chenyang Zhou; Zhengding Hu; Shuyi Pei; Yangwook Kang; Yufei Ding; Po-An Tsai
affiliations: UCSD, Indiana University Bloomington, Columbia University, Samsung Semiconductor, NVIDIA
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Collective communication, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Random expert selection in 200B-1000B MoE LLMs (DeepSeek-V3, Llama-4-Maverick, Qwen3-235B, Kimi-K2) makes data movement (MoE all-to-all and expert weight transfer) the dominant 60%-90% latency component on multi-GPU and emerging wafer-scale systems. Without a system-agnostic characterization of how expert selections correlate across layers, tokens, prefill/decode and tasks, prefetching/caching/replication strategies remain ad hoc and tied to specific platforms.
problem_statement.zh: 在 200B-1000B 規模的 MoE LLM（DeepSeek-V3、Llama-4-Maverick、Qwen3-235B、Kimi-K2）中，隨機 expert 選擇使資料搬移（MoE all-to-all 與 expert weight 傳輸）成為多 GPU 與新興 wafer-scale 系統上佔據 60%-90% 延遲的主導因素。在缺乏跨層、跨 token、跨 prefill/decode 與跨任務之 expert 選擇關聯的系統無關（system-agnostic）特徵化研究下，prefetching、caching、replication 策略仍各自綁定特定平台。

key_innovation.en: A model-centric, data-movement profiling study of four 2025 SOTA MoE models over 24,000 requests producing 150 GB of expert-selection traces. It distills six insights (layer-level correlation, token-level correlation, prefill-decode correlation, single-expert imbalance, expert-pair affinity, task/language influence) and applies them in two case studies: (i) a wafer-scale GPU two-level data-placement-aware command processor + ATU/PDU hardware extension, and (ii) a prefill-aware expert-placement algorithm for existing 8xH100 GPUs. The forecasting itself is a lightweight ML predictor in the PDU prediction table.
key_innovation.zh: 以 model-centric、資料搬移為核心的剖析研究：對 2025 年四個 SOTA MoE 模型、24,000 筆請求進行系統無關之 profiling，產出 150 GB 的 expert-selection trace，萃取六項洞察（layer 關聯、token 關聯、prefill-decode 關聯、單一 expert 不均衡、expert-pair 共啟動親和、任務與語言影響），並以兩個案例研究應用：(i) 在 wafer-scale GPU 上新增 data-placement-aware command processor 與 ATU/PDU 硬體擴充的二級記憶體管理；(ii) 在既有 8xH100 上採 prefill-aware 的 expert placement 演算法；資料搬移預測本身則以輕量 ML predictor 於 PDU prediction table 實作。

baselines_compared: EP baseline (SGLang), MoE-Lightning, CoServe, Comet, MegaScale-Infer, MoEntwine (placement), Dojo and TSMC SoW (hardware references)

key_improvements.en: 6.6x average MoE throughput speedup on wafer-scale GPUs across four 200B-1000B models with minor hardware modifications; up to 1.25x MoE-layer speedup on existing 8xH100 systems; hop-number reduction up to 277x relative to baseline on wafer-scale; multi-chiplet GPU simulator validated within 5% error against measurements.
key_improvements.zh: 於四個 200B-1000B 模型於 wafer-scale GPU 平均提升 MoE 吞吐量 6.6x（僅需少量硬體修改）；既有 8xH100 系統上 MoE 層加速最高 1.25x；wafer-scale 上 hop 數最高降至基線的 1/277；多 chiplet GPU 模擬器與實機量測誤差控制於 5% 以內。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200, simulated TSMC SoW wafer (24 dies, 96 HBM dies, 3 TB HBM, H100-like 1000 TFLOPS FP16 per die), simulated Dojo 5x5 2D mesh, Dojo-Enhanced B300-like 4500 TFLOPS variant
gpu_count: 8x H100 DGX (real measurement); 8x H200 AWS instance (real measurement); 5x5 and 8x3 wafer chiplet meshes in simulation
node_count: 1-2 nodes for real measurement; wafer-scale single-package simulated
reported_accuracy: Custom event-driven multi-chiplet simulator validated within 5% error vs. 8xH100 measurements for single-GPU execution and P2P; Spearman ratio >= 0.7 between prefill and decode expert frequencies confirms predictability; quantitative accuracy of the PDU predictor itself is not reported as a single MAPE figure.
validation_workloads: MMLU, MMLU-Pro (Chinese), ChineseSimpleQA, LiveCodeBench (>24,000 requests per model, >2000 GPU-hours of profiling, 150 GB of traces)

scope_assumptions.en: Profiling is system-agnostic and model-centric (insights independent of platform); two case-study evaluations are platform-specific: (a) wafer-scale assumes single-GPU-like programming model with command processor extensions, mesh D2D bandwidth 1.7 TB/s and HBM 3.35 TB/s, LLC 64 MB, 10% DRAM reserved for system overhead; (b) existing-GPU case study covers only the decode stage MoE layer throughput. Custom Python event-driven simulator does not model microarchitecture in detail; calibrated against 8xH100. Predictor implementation details (size, training cost) are not reported in the main text.
scope_assumptions.zh: Profiling 為系統無關且 model-centric（洞察獨立於平台）；兩個案例評估則屬平台特定：(a) wafer-scale 假設採用 single-GPU-like 程式模型加上 command processor 擴充，mesh D2D 頻寬 1.7 TB/s、HBM 3.35 TB/s，LLC 64 MB，DRAM 保留 10% 給系統開銷；(b) 既有 GPU 案例僅涵蓋 decode 階段 MoE 層吞吐量。自製 Python event-driven simulator 不細緻建模 microarchitecture，已以 8xH100 校正。predictor 的實作細節（規模、訓練成本）主文未具體說明。
